newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: LEIGHTON SHARES LEAP ON PROFIT, DIVIDEND.
newsitem.headline: LEIGHTON SHARES LEAP ON PROFIT, DIVIDEND.

text.p: Shares in construction and contract mining group Leighton Holdings Ltd leapt over six percent to A$6.15 on Thursday after the company announced a sharply higher annual profit and a special dividend of 10 cents.
The company posted a 32 percent higher pre-abnormals net profit of A$86.24 million, above the range forecast by analysts of A$79 million to A$85.4 million.
Net profit after abnormals was A$132.11 million, up from A$70.21 a year earlier due to abnormal gain of A$46 million.
Final dividend jumped to 13 cents from 8.5 cents in the previous corresponding period.
